lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The shop bell gives a rusty jingle. Someone is standing in the doorway.

lines.speaker: gus
lines.text: Saw the lights on. Didn't think anyone would ever bake in here again.

lines.speaker: grandma
lines.text: Gus always did say that. Then he'd buy two loaves. Be nice to him, dear.

lines.speaker: gus
lines.text: Well. If there's bread tomorrow, I'll be back.
